surface: Dini — constant negative Gaussian curvature K = -1/(a^2+b^2)
sine_gordon: phi_uv = sin(phi); kink soliton corresponds to Dini b parameter

outside_sources.author: Eisenhart LP
outside_sources.title: A Treatise on the Differential Geometry of Curves and Surfaces
outside_sources.notes: Sections 174-178: pseudospherical surfaces, Bäcklund transform, constant negative curvature. Related: do Carmo MP (1976) Differential Geometry of Curves and Surfaces, Prentice-Hall (standard modern reference); Spivak M (1979) A Comprehensive Introduction to Differential Geometry Vol 3, Publish or Perish.

outside_sources.author: Bäcklund AV
outside_sources.title: Ueber Flächen-Transformationen
outside_sources.notes: Original paper introducing the Bäcklund transform for pseudospherical surfaces. The transform maps Σ → Σ̃ preserving K = -1/r² and satisfying the sine-Gordon equation φ_uv = sin φ. Related: Rogers C & Schief WK (2002) Bäcklund and Darboux Transformations, Cambridge Univ Press; Hirota R (1972) Phys Rev Lett 27:1192 exact N-soliton solution of sine-Gordon via Bäcklund chain.
